title: kraizipack
description: Fabric optimization, some tweaks, improvements and visual effects
body:
# **ABOUT MODPACK**

**The modpack adds graphics, interface, and performance improvements without changing the core mechanics of the game.**

**Graphics and environment:** dynamic lighting from items and entities, improved clouds, sky, water and rain, falling leaves and wind animation, ability to install custom entity models and textures, sound physics and ambient sounds, enchantment glint outline, particle and explosion effects.

**Interface and controls:** information panels with FPS, coordinates, time and effect timers, inventory sorting and quick item scrolling, shulker box content preview, player heads display in chat, improved advancements tree and statistics screen, smooth interface and scrolling animation, dynamic crosshair and zoom, disabling resource pack warnings.

**Tools for builders:** creating and loading building schematics with Litematica, mass world editing with WorldEdit, powerful editor Axiom.

**Performance optimization:** improved chunk loading and world generation, reduced memory usage, culling of invisible entities, network code optimization.

**Compatibility:** connecting to older server versions via ViaFabricPlus.

Also endermens cannot pick up blocks for performance reasons and to prevent annoying random blocks on the surface.

# **IMPORTANT WARNING!**
This modpack may contain mods that are banned on some servers. Before using them, check with the server administration to avoid being banned.
